_comment: EDIT THIS FILE with your real hostel details before going live. The bot reads answers from here.
mess_timings: Breakfast 7:30-9:00 AM, Lunch 12:30-2:00 PM, Snacks 5:00-5:45 PM, Dinner 7:30-9:15 PM

mess_menu.Monday: Breakfast: Poha, tea | Lunch: Rice, dal, mixed veg, roti | Dinner: Jeera rice, paneer curry, roti
mess_menu.Tuesday: Breakfast: Idli, sambar | Lunch: Rice, rajma, roti | Dinner: Veg pulao, raita
mess_menu.Wednesday: Breakfast: Aloo paratha, curd | Lunch: Rice, dal fry, bhindi, roti | Dinner: Chapati, chole
mess_menu.Thursday: Breakfast: Upma, chutney | Lunch: Rice, kadhi, aloo gobi, roti | Dinner: Fried rice, manchurian
mess_menu.Friday: Breakfast: Bread omelette / jam toast | Lunch: Rice, dal tadka, cabbage, roti | Dinner: Veg biryani, raita
mess_menu.Saturday: Breakfast: Puri bhaji | Lunch: Rice, sambar, mix veg, roti | Dinner: Roti, dal makhani, sweet
mess_menu.Sunday: Breakfast: Dosa, chutney | Lunch: Special thali | Dinner: Roti, paneer butter masala, ice cream

laundry: Laundry pickup Mon/Thu 8-10 AM at the ground-floor laundry room. Washing machines on each floor are free 6-9 AM and 3-6 PM.
wifi: Connect to the SSID 'HOSTEL-WIFI' and log in with your student ID. If the router on your floor is off or slow, file a complaint with category 'Internet'.
warden_contact: Warden office: +91-00000-00000 (9 AM - 6 PM). Night security desk: +91-00000-11111. Caretaker: +91-00000-22222.
rules: Gate closes at 10:00 PM (late entry needs prior warden approval). Visitors allowed 10 AM - 6 PM in the visitors' lounge only. Cooking appliances and heaters are not allowed in rooms. Night-out needs a signed outing slip.
fees: Check the exact amount and due date on the college fee portal or with the accounts office. The hostel office can issue a fee receipt on request.
emergency_numbers: Emergency: call 112. Ambulance: 108. Fire: 101. Hostel night security: +91-00000-11111.
wellbeing_support: Tele-MANAS (free, 24x7 mental-health helpline): 14416. Emergency: 112. Campus counselling centre: [ADD CONTACT HERE].
